name: codex-companion
description: Live companion view of what the current Codex chat is doing and the decisions it makes.

interface.shortDescription: See what the agent is doing and why
interface.longDescription: Ends every turn with a short Outcome and Next step that the local dashboard at http://127.0.0.1:8787 turns into an inbox of your chats, and lets the agent log the decisions it makes.
defaultPrompt: End your answers in the companion handoff format.
